messages:
Maya R.: heads up — after landing AWQ-compact profile on new-llama-variant we saw a 3.7% drop on our structured-extract suite and a weird CSV cell-swap in several examples. minimal repro attached below.
Devin K.: can you paste an example input + expected vs actual?
Maya R.: sure — input snippet: 
```
Prompt: extract table rows from HTML snippet
Expected: ["2022-01-01, Payment, $12.00"]
Actual: ["Payment, 2022-01-01, $12.00"]
```
Maya R.: format shift not total hallucination — fields present but ordering scrambled. happens on ~6k requests/day in canary.
Oli P.: interesting. any difference between batch=1 vs batch=8? AWQ might be reordering internal tokens with shared KV under batching. can you re-run with batch=1?
Maya R.: ran quick: batch=1 looks fine, batch>=4 shows the swap. logs: 
```
[runner] start request id=zzz seq_len=128 batch=8 profile=awq-compact
[kv] shard=3 evict_hint=1
[tokenize] tokens=...
[decode] emit_order: default
```
Devin K.: kv eviction hint stands out. maybe mixed-shard KV pointer race when bucketed across batch dims. did we change shard_count for AWQ profile?
Maya R.: shard_count unchanged. AWQ uses smaller per-shard buffers but more aggressive packing.
Sanjay G.: assigning myself. first hypothesis: packing + continuous-batching introduces non-deterministic decode ordering for certain response templates. test: disable continuous-batching on canary and re-run. also include seed=42 for determinism.
Maya R.: will run now, posting results in ~20m.
bench-bot: scheduled smoke run: env=canary profile=awq-compact batch=8 seed=42 run_id=run-20260320-01
Maya R.: result: disabling continuous-batching removes the CSV swap on 99% of samples. with cbatch enabled, reproducible.
Oli P.: ok that narrows it. likely a bug in how outputs are concatenated when multiple KV-streams flush. can you grab raw token sequences for a failing request? prefixed tokens + emitted indices.
Maya R.: attached token dumps (pasted to onboarding bucket). example shows interleaved token indices across examples in the batch.
Devin K.: looks like an off-by-one in the per-request emission offset when decompressing AWQ packed outputs. assigning to me to patch. quick fix: enforce per-request emission cursor that is reset per sample before decode merge.
Sanjay G.: also check fallback: we should route batch>1 to gptq variant until patch lands for canary customers. set routing policy for canary flag=awq-compact->gptq-fallback for next 24h.
modelops-bot: rollout policy updated: awq-compact canary -> gptq-fallback if batch_size>1 (effective immediately).
Maya R.: thanks. will monitor. postmortem notes: QA should include batch-shaping tests (1,4,8) for structured-output tasks during quant profile onboarding. add to onboarding checklist.
Devin K.: PR incoming with test + fix, will ping when merged. :thumbsup:
Maya R.: awesome — leaving this thread open until we've run a full 24h canary.
